candidates.explanation: Service-first backlog protection with strict no-trim-when-backlogged. Adds small capped orders when backlog exists and pipeline is thin; trims only when backlog is zero and pipeline is clearly excessive. Avoids growth triggers and never reduces while backlog is positive, addressing the dominant under-ordering failure.

rules.when: backlog > 0 and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
backlog > 0 and pipeline < 0.5 * recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware damping with backlog-gated relaxation. Trims only when backlog is zero and pipeline exceeds three times recent demand; boosts modestly when backlog is present and pipeline is below recent. Uses small symmetric deltas to avoid starving downstream after pipeline delay.

rules.when: pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
backlog > 0 and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
backlog > 2 * recent and pipeline < 1.5 * recent and recent > 0

rules.when: backlog > 2 * recent and pipeline < 1.5 * recent and recent > 0
backlog > 0 and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
